closed_finding.issue: An active copied-context call could outlive diagnostic_scope and retain/accept model baseline after authority expiry. Existing r2 controls missed this active-child lifetime.
closed_finding.resolution: r3 Arm owns the single active capsule; arm-to-call lock order serializes mark/close/expiry. Authority exit immediately clears capsule baseline/rows and arm reference/sink; closed expiry is idempotent and emits nothing. Four component assertions and two copied-worker cases cover before/after baseline retention.
